description: Commit messages (or paths: search_in=paths) by keywords, best match first; every word, case-insensitive. Each commit: sha, commit_id, branch, branches (its branch, then its back-patches': a back-patched fix appears once per branch, so pick by branch), first_release (first final release on its branch containing it, or null), message, author, date, people, mail_refs (up to 5, with how_it_refers). A SHA or 7+ hex prefix returns that commit.
name: git_search
